evidence_quote: This study investigates the role of ectonucleotide pyrophosphatase/phosphodiesterase 3 (ENPP3) as a potential therapeutic target and immune-checkpoint enzyme in ccRCC.
rationale: The study focuses on renal cancer growth and anti-tumor immunity through ENPP3 blockade. The abstract does not connect these mechanisms or treatments to the brain, neural function, neural injury, or neurological disorders.
